headline: Backman's sacrifice fly wins it after a three-run ninth
recap: The Phillies trailed the Cubs 5-3 entering the bottom of the ninth at Veterans Stadium and won 6-5. Chicago had scored twice in the top of the ninth to break a 3-3 tie. Randy Ready walked to open the bottom half, Ricky Jordan singled him to third, and Wes Chamberlain's single scored Ready to make it 5-4. Jim Lindeman's single tied the game, and after a walk to Dale Murphy, Wally Backman's sacrifice fly to left scored Chamberlain with the winning run.

Andy Ashby started and went 5.2 innings, allowing six hits and two runs with four walks and two strikeouts. Chicago's Shawn Boskie went 4.2 innings against him, giving up five hits and three runs. Wally Ritchie got the win with 0.2 innings, and Bruce Ruffin threw 1.1 hitless innings.

Chamberlain finished 2 for 4 with a home run, three RBI and three runs scored. His two-run homer in the fifth put the Phillies up 3-1. Dickie Thon also had two hits for Philadelphia, and Andre Dawson went 2 for 4 for Chicago.
